exposure: Specific sites of fibroids (lower segment of the uterus, cervix, uterine cornu, adjacent to uterine vessels or interstitial part of fallopian tube)
Larger fibroid size (diameter >7.5 cm for single, total diameter >14.5 cm for multiple)
Bilateral uterine artery ligation before myomectomy
Administration of potent uterotonic drugs before myomectomy
cohort: The study included 1002 women with fibroids >=4 cm in diameter who underwent cesarean myomectomy at the Shenyang Women's and Children's Hospital from January 2014 to November 2022.
finding: Independent risk factors for PPH following cesarean myomectomy included multiple fibroids, specific fibroid locations, longer surgery duration, and larger fibroid size, while bilateral uterine artery ligation and potent uterotonic drugs were protective factors.
